reviews.comment:
Si te sobra el tiempo  carga en esta YPF, el ACÁ se desprestigia con tan mala atención el Playero le hizo un service al auto de adelante, que aceite, agua, vidrios… y luego le fue a inflar las ruedas. Demore 35 min en cargar. Teniendo 1 solo auto delante

(Translated by Google)
If you have extra time, fill up at this YPF station. The ACA station is losing its reputation with such poor service. The attendant serviced the car in front of me—oil, coolant, windows—and then went to inflate the tires. It took me 35 minutes to fill up, even though there was only one car ahead of me.
